{{Quote|The great army of Gardulla is on the way!|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] aide|<ref name="Outlander">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref>}}
'''Gardulla Besadii the Elder''', better known as '''Gardulla the Hutt''', was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine-natured]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who vied for control of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Great Peace of the Republic|last centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The mother of [[Gardulla Besadii the Younger]] and [[Decca Besadii Diori]], Gardulla was the one-time owner of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] and [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] until she lost them to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] in a podracing bet. This weakness for excessive gambling continually marred her long life with failure and defeat, and led to her downfall in a pronounced rivalry with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], who usurped control of Tatooine and attempted to have her assassinated. Gardulla survived, but by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was reduced to serving as Jabba's representative on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Biography==
===Consequences of gambling and crime===
[[File:GTH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gardulla about to gamble over the next big [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]]]]
Born in [[700 BBY]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="BH" /> Gardulla's criminal activities flourished during the golden age of her rule, in which her use of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] would seem to have granted her great fortune, although it caused numerous conflicts between her and the more powerful [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. At one point, she resorted to a limited partnership with Jabba, who would become her greatest rival, after she lost her entire fortune on gambling. Gardulla still maintained power over her slave trade franchise.

The Republic soon outlawed slavery in the Outer Rim Territories, as soon as the two Hutts' agreement was reached; Gardulla was to be sentenced to life in prison. Eventually, though, she escaped and returned to Tatooine, where she would control her failing criminal empire.

Rumors of a romance between Gardulla and Jabba erupted, with her presence at his [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|Tatooine townhome]] only fueling the speculation.<ref name="DB" /> Her true motivations remained her own.

===Gardulla's revenge===
{{Quote|Fortunately, longevity comes naturally to my species... But I don't want for enemies of a different sort, Magister. Enemies who would like nothing more than to see me in an early grave... They are precisely the reason I wish to remove myself from Nal Hutta—and from the likes of Jabba Desilijic Tiure and the rest. With your financial assistance I can accomplish that.|Gardulla petitions [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] for the run of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]|<ref name=":0">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], fueled by her desire to wrest Tatooine from the clutches of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt clan]], the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] and notorious [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] traveled (by secret invitation) to the occult [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] of [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]] and there petitioned [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] (the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]) to fund her planned takeover of the arid [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] planet. Gardulla considered Damask's financial power and [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IBC]] connections as key to a successful grab for Tatooine, which included plans for the building of a [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Podrace course]] that would make those of the rest of the galaxy seem like amateur runs. At the root of her proposal, of course, were unexampled [[Gambling/Legends|gambling profits]] to be realized, a worthwhile portion of which she promised to reserve for her 'silent partner'. The powerful Muun agreed to the proposition, along with his own stipulation that Gardulla allow an arrangement-of-favor to be struck on behalf of a [[Cabra|crime-boss acquaintance]] (who was set to soon answer to [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] overlord [[Alexi Garyn]], concurrently being groomed for leadership by the crime syndicate). She reluctantly agreed, and Damask sealed the deal by promising to advance her the needed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for her Podrace enterprise through the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]].<ref name=":0" />

More than thirty standard years later Damask reneged on the agreement, when in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], he struck a new deal with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to allow the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] the self-proclaimed title of Tatooine 'overseer' by ceasing to fund Gardulla's ventures (Jabba wanted economic siege for his rival, to 'starve her out'). In exchange, Jabba promised to reveal to Damask valuable secret information regarding the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-worshiping cult and criminal terrorist organization assailing Damask's interests in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], truly an agitating thorn in the Sith Lord's side: that its new leader [[Komari Vosa]] (former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]]) was in league with Gardulla in a contaminated [[Death stick/Legends|death-stick]] [[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter|operation]] to supply the Bando Gora with 'brain dead' recruits. In light of this incriminating information against the Besadii Hutt, Damask felt fully justified.<ref name=":0" />

But feeling betrayed herself, Gardulla soon joined forces with Vosa's notorious terrorist group, corrupt [[Ars Veruna/Legends|King Veruna]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and the Black Sun crime syndicate to wreak revenge on Damask by targeting with an [[Maul: Lockdown|ill-gotten]] [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear warhead]] his clandestine outpost on the Sojourn-[[Moon/Legends|moon]]. But, courtesy of Jabba's spy network and personal starship interceptor [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], Damask escaped the bombardment (an attack carried out concurrently with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Eriadu Summit]] with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], at which event Damask orchestrated and delivered his own powerful attack).<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> With the aid of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and his [[Darth Maul/Legends|Zabrak assassin]], the IBC magnate/Sith Lord then took [[Alexi Garyn#Enemy of the Sith|quick revenge]] upon [[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter|all parties]] involved in the plot against his life, with the exception of Gardulla, whom he left to Jabba (and Darth Sidious, whom he didn't suspect, but who in fact was the mastermind of the nuclear attack, having merely used weak-minded individuals to carry out his will, allowing them the belief that they alone were responsible). Palpatine had learned, moments before the Eriadu Trade Summit was to commence, that [[Foreign Affairs scandal|scandalous]] King Veruna had quite suddenly abdicated his throne to young [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] (upon learning from the exultant Jabba that Damask was still very much alive). Damask decreed, therefore, that he himself would personally attend to the [[Ars Veruna#Dark Side death|Naboo monarch's dark but deserved fate]].<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Annie_and_friends.png|thumb|right|200px|Gardulla lost the Ghostling children due to Skywalker and his friends.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], less than two weeks before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Gardulla—a connoisseur in exotic alien creatures, which she unabashedly housed in [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|her great palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on Tatooine—kidnapped, with the purpose to enslave as ornaments in her luxurious if notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]], several [[Ghostling]] children. These delicate and beautiful native creatures of the planet [[Datar/Legends|Datar]] were rescued from that heinous fate through the brave exploits of young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his childhood friends, including the boy [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]], and the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pala Kwi'teksa]]. Anakin, Kitster, and Pala, had all been enslaved to Gardulla within the walls of her fortress as very young children, before Anakin and Pala were acquired by new masters; hence, they knew one another intimately and had been the best of friends for as long as they could remember. As soon as one of the children responsible for the theft of the Ghostlings had been identified by using a [[DNA/Legends|DNA scanner]] on a small piece of skin found at the scene of the crime, Gardulla sought revenge against the children by attempting to activate Pala's [[Slave tracking device|implanted slave tracking chip]], which would have exploded and killed her had it not been for the [[signal scrambler]] device that Anakin had constructed and gifted to his friend to protect her.<ref>''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''; [[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]; [[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]; [[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>

===The Boonta Eve Classic===
Gardulla, whose grand plans for a [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|peerless Podrace course]] were eclipsed over the years by Jabba's own, had been a longtime supporter of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] podracer, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. Before the spectacular [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|32 BBY]] in which Sebulba was to participate, Gardulla tried to trick Jabba into thinking a less likely racer, the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], would win. She predictably failed in her cunning and felt she was tricked herself, in that Jabba's [[R5-X2/Legends|astromech]] droid had determined Anakin Skywalker might succeed. She had wagered that he'd lose, and to be sure, Gardulla employed the use of her majordomo, [[Diva Funquita/Legends|Diva Funquita]], to find someone in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to sabotage the boy's podracer.<ref name=":2">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>

Funquita hired the [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] racer, [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark "Bumpy" Roose]], to carry out the job. But Roose erroneously sabotaged the podracer of [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. The effect of this was apparent when the race began and Skywalker busted through to a top place after a slow start while Quadrinaros' racer awaited its eventual explosive doom (when the racers came around for the second lap) at the starting point, having barely moved past the first-lap start line.<ref name=":2" /> Gardulla, the plot's originator, surely had to have been humbled as well as infuriated.

After the race, Gardulla tried to persuade Watto to sell Anakin back to her. Unfortunately, Watto was never able to retrieve the boy from [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who took him away to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name=":1">''[[Episode I: Qui-Gon Jinn]]''</ref>

[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] remained in Watto's service, until years later when he sold her to moisture farmer [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], who promptly freed and married her.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Battle in the Jundland Wastes===
The attack on the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of Tatooine's [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] would end up being the ultimate triumph and failure of Gardulla the Hutt. It traced its origins years back to when the Hutts were stuck with a junk surplus of weapons in the possession of [[Dreddon]] the Hutt. Jabba conceived the idea of sending thugs to raid Tusken camps, in turn causing the Sand People to raid nearby settlements, which gave the civilians a need for weaponry. Jabba then continually sold portions of Dreddon's surplus at inflated prices, increasing the profit of the Hutts. He remained the hero.<ref name="Outlander" />

[[File:Gardulla_Desert.jpg|thumb|right|Gardulla the Hutt on her personal [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|desert skiff]]]]
Gardulla decided to assemble all her criminal forces to launch an assault on the Tusken Raiders, dispatching the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to personally assassinate the unknown Jedi leader, [[Sharad Hett]]. Her plan was to puncture the Tusken Raider defenses and slay all in the army's path, thus ending the "Tusken threat" and stopping Jabba's weapon franchise. She hoped that [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] would then see to it, at last, that she managed Tatooine.<ref name="Outlander" />

Gardulla's plot for wresting Tatooine power from the Desilijic Hutt clan failed, and the crimelord was forced to retreat to her palace in Mos Espa—but not without the mortifying and degrading assistance of her arch-rival, Jabba, who was tipped off by Sing (revealing the bounty hunter to be a double agent).<ref name="Outlander" />

At some point, Gardulla presumably established [[Gardulla Oola]] hotel in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="phraseguide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

===Jango Fett===
{{Quote|There's one more thing, Gardulla: Jabba sends his regards.|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="BH" />}}
[[File:GardullasDeath.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] pushes Gardulla into the jaws of her [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]]]]
Possibly a year or more before [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], Gardulla became associated with [[Komari Vosa]], leader of the deadly [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] terrorist cult. Gardulla used her resources to transport for the Bando Gora special mind-altering substances to the [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and drug producer [[Sebolto]] to create tainted "[[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]" for [[Groff Haugg|trafficking]]; these death sticks would turn already 'brain-dead' addicts into mindless, brainwashed slaves, whom Gardulla would then dispatch to Vosa as new cult 'recruits'. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], on Darth Sidious' order, dispatched bounty hunters [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]] to track down and destroy the cult; Fett and his partner [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] followed leads across the galaxy that eventually led to Gardulla. While changing into a "disguise", the shapeshifting [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] Wesell was captured and imprisoned in Gardulla's dungeons, and there waited to be fed to her pet [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|canyon krayt dragon]].<ref name="BH" />

Gardulla did not know that Zam was working with Jango Fett. On a tip from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Jango infiltrated [[Imperial Station Bravo|Gardulla's palace]] soon afterward. When the bounty hunter refused to release Wesell from her cell so that Gardulla's pet might feast, the Hutt called for her guards, and Jango was captured. Brought before the Hutt crime lord, Jango was to be fed to her krayt dragon instead, and Wesell was to be sold as a slave. Jango managed to escape the jaws of the krayt dragon, and after defeating legions of armed guards, he at last burst into Gardulla's throne room. Jango interrogated the Hutt about Komari Vosa, but she refused to tell him anything, saying the bounty hunter didn't know what he was up against; Gardulla then released her krayt dragon into the throne room to finish Jango off. To prove her wrong and fulfill his mission, Jango then maneuvered behind Gardulla and pushed her off her throne into the beast arena. She was then promptly devoured by the dragon in a matter of seconds. But Jango Fett had killed the krayt dragon before it could fully digest her, allowing Gardulla to crawl out of its stomach and exit through its mouth and survived her encounter with the bounty hunter.<ref name="BH" />

===Working for Jabba===
[[File:Gardulla_with_Dancer.png|thumb|220px|Gardulla, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] representative on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Council of Elders]], with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer.]]
{{Quote|No one can outsmart a Hutt! And no one can digest a Hutt, either!|[[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]|<ref name="PotDS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], circumstances found her working for Jabba, serving as his representative on Nal Hutta. She, along with the other heads of the five Hutt families, listened to Ziro the Hutt's testimony regarding a holo-diary which listed the many heinous crimes of the Hutt Council. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] arrived on Nal Hutta to report that Ziro had escaped with the help of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], Gardulla told Kenobi that she and the rest of the council knew of this already. After Vos stated that he thought that the Hutt Council was behind Ziro's escape, Gardulla threatened him, saying that if Vos were alone, he would not be allowed to leave alive. After Ziro escaped, Gardulla and the Council hired Cad Bane to track down both the diary and Ziro, who had just escaped with the help of [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]. Unknown to Gardulla, Sy was also hired by Jabba to kill Ziro once the diary was in her possession. Sy easily killed Ziro and delivered the diary to Jabba before Bane could arrive.<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref><ref name="Hunt for Ziro Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gardulla's voice in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' was provided by [[Susan Boyd]].

Although Gardulla made an appearance in the 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] TV series, In ''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]'' Gardulla is regarded as being dead and succeeded by her daughter [[Decca Besadii Diori|Decca The Hutt]]. There is no official explanation behind this discrepancy.
